Perform a Patch Test: Apply a small amount to the target area 24 hours before a full application to check for allergic reactions or chemical burns.
Apply Evenly: Spread a thick layer over the hair without rubbing it in.
Time It Carefully: Leave the cream on for the time specified on the label (usually 4–6 minutes), never exceeding 10 minutes total.
Rinse Thoroughly: Use a damp cloth or the provided spatula in the shower to wipe away the cream and hair, then rinse the skin completely with water.
Wait Between Uses: Always wait at least 72 hours (3 days) before applying cream to the same area again.
Avoid Sensitive Zones: Do not use standard body creams on your face, head, ears, nipples, or broken/sunburned skin unless the product is specifically formulated for it.
